title: Pippi Longstocking
author: Astrid Lindgren
summary: Nine-year-old Pippi lives alone with a horse and a monkey in a house on the edge of a Swedish town, and she is absurdly strong. She befriends her neighbours Tommy and Annika and turns every day into mischief.
readIf: you want an anarchic, cheerful children's classic to read aloud or revisit.
skipIf: you dislike episodic stories without much overall plot.
